svg.aria-label: A patch of the densest lattice packing of the smoothed octagon K: the copies K + 2Λ, Λ = Z s₀* + Z s₁*, of covolume √12 and density area(K)/√12 = (8 − 4√2 − ln 2)/(2√2 − 1) ≈ 0.902414. The central copy touches its six neighbours at the vertices s_j* of its critical hexagon (black), a hexagon of area 3√3/2 inscribed in K
